lines.text: On the Sabbath, Jesus' disciples rub heads of grain in their hands and eat them, and some Pharisees object.
Jesus says that hungry David entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, lawful only for the elders.
Jesus declares that the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.
On another Sabbath in the synagogue, the scribes and Pharisees watch Jesus, and He tells the man with the withered left hand to stand.
Jesus tells the man to stretch out his hand, it is restored, and the scribes and Pharisees are filled with rage.
